items.headline: Coastal Flood Watch issued November 24 at 10:27AM EST until November 26 at 11:00AM EST by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to 2 feet of inundation above ground level
possible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...Eastern Currituck County.

* WHEN...From late Wednesday night through Thursday morning.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
may be inundated. Some shoreline erosion may occur.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 24 at 9:59AM EST until November 25 at 10:00PM EST by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northeast winds 20 to 25
kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas 7 to 10 ft. For the Storm
Watch, east winds 30 to 40 kt with gusts up to 50 kt and seas
10 to 15 ft possible.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Parramore Island to Cape Charles
Light VA out 20 NM, Coastal Waters from Cape Charles Light to
Virginia-North Carolina border out 20 NM and Coastal waters
from NC VA border to Currituck Beach Light NC out 20 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 10 PM EST
Wednesday. For the Storm Watch, from Wednesday evening through
Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...Storm force winds and hazardous seas could capsize
or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should prepare to remain in port, alter course, and/or
secure the vessel before the onset of severe conditions.
